hospitals.name: Priscilla Chan & Mark Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital & Trauma Center
hospitals.operator: City & County of San Francisco, Dept of Public Health (San Francisco Health Network)

fap.title: San Francisco Health Network Charity Care and Discount Payment Program Policy and Procedure (v.05112026)

free_care.quote: A patient's household income may not exceed 138% of the Federal poverty level.
free_care.extra_conditions: must cooperate with insurance/third-party recovery and with Medicare/Medi-Cal/other coverage screening and application

discount.rule: household income >= 139% FPL, no upper limit; FPL determines the size of the discount (the discount schedule itself is NOT published in the policy)
discount.quote: There is no FPL limit for a patient to qualify. The patient's FPL determines the amount of the discount.

payment_cap.rule: patients <= 400% FPL: expected payment limited to what Medicare would pay
payment_cap.quote: limits the expected payment for services it provides to patients at or below 400% of the FPL, to the amount of payment the hospital would expect to receive from Medicare.

fap.high_medical_cost: Policy history says the high-medical-cost criterion was eliminated in 2019 (discount program open to all FPL levels instead).
other: Patient Cap: SFDPH applies an automatic predetermined maximum patient balance for qualifying patients/accounts without an application (amount not published in the policy).
Appeals within 15 business days of a decision.

Payment plans: <= 10% of family income after essential expenses; if no agreement, deduct 60% of gross household income for essential living expenses then take 10% of the remainder. Plans under $20/month or over 12 months are sent to the Bureau of Delinquent Revenue.

ER physician fees are billed separately by UCSF Clinical Practice Group dba SFGH Medical Group (its Guarantor/AB1020 policy is attached to the same PDF: limits payment to the greater of Medicare or Medi-Cal for patients <= 400% FPL).
Policy says patients without an accepted verifiable source of income will be found ineligible; and earlier history notes charity threshold was 500% FPL from 2019, now 138%.

billing_phones.purpose: Patient Accounting customer service / payment plans
billing_phones.source: FAP PDF and ZSFG billing page

mrf.found_via: https://www.zuckerbergsanfranciscogeneral.org/services/billing-financial-assistance/ ('CMS Regulations Machine Readable File' link). No cms-hhs-pricetransparency.txt at the domain root (HTTP 404).

hospitals.name: UCSF Medical Center (Parnassus, Mission Bay, Mount Zion; one license 220000091)
hospitals.address: 505 Parnassus Ave, San Francisco, CA 94143 (Mission Bay: 1975 4th St, 94158)
hospitals.operator: University of California, San Francisco (UCSF Health)

fap.title: UCSF Policy 3.04.07 Patient Financial Assistance, Prescription Assistance, and Charity Care
fap.verified: opened (hospital_page: cited in FAP, not opened)

free_care.rule: Self-pay (no third-party coverage) and family income <= 400% FPL -> 100% write-off
free_care.quote: Family Income at or below 400% of the Federal Poverty Level (FPL)

high_medical_cost_free_care.rule: Insured and (family income <= 400% FPL OR out-of-pocket medical expenses in prior 12 months > 10% of family income) -> 100% write-off of patient responsibility
high_medical_cost_free_care.note: As written the criteria list uses 'and ... ; or', so the >10% out-of-pocket test may apply at any income; confirm with UCSF.

discount.rule: No separate partial-discount tier above 400% FPL found in the policy.

other: Policy covers hospital inpatient/outpatient incl. hospital-based professional fees; excludes separately billed physician fees.
Policy asks for 'best efforts' to apply within 240 days of first bill; CA law (HSC 127405(e)(3)) bars application deadlines.
Extended payment plans interest-free; <= 10% of monthly family income after essential living expenses.

mrf.found_via: https://www.ucsfhealth.org/about/price-transparency ('UCSF Medical Center Standard Charges'). No cms-hhs-pricetransparency.txt at www.ucsfhealth.org (404).

hospitals.name: California Pacific Medical Center - Van Ness Campus
hospitals.address: 1101 Van Ness Ave, San Francisco, CA

fap.title: Policy On Financial Assistance for Sutter Hospitals (Charity Care), effective 2026-01-01

free_care.rule: Uninsured and family income <= 400% FPL -> full write-off of hospital charges
free_care.quote: Patient is an Uninsured Patient with a family income (as defined below) at or below 400% of the most recent FPL.

high_medical_cost_free_care.rule: Insured, family income <= 400% FPL, and out-of-pocket medical expenses (past 12 months) > 10% of family income -> write-off of patient responsibility

discount.rule: No partial-discount tier found in policy text. The internal worksheet (Attachment) mentions a 'Catastrophic' write-off where patient liability above 30% of annual income is written off, but the policy body does not define eligibility for it.

other: Refunds of credit balances include 10% per annum interest (HSC 127440); not if under $5.
Disputes: notify hospital CFO/designee within 30 days.
Excludes separately billed physicians incl. ER physicians.

mrf.caveat: No payer-specific negotiated dollar amounts on the ED E/M rows; discounted cash = gross charge.
